svg.aria-label: From anonymous visitor to paying customer: one person's timeline (anonymous visitor, trial user, paying customer) beside four cards: real-time segments spot who is ready to buy, web push and ad audiences bring visitors back, journeys run email, in-app and SMS, goals and funnels show what converts.
